items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Well Peter was, they had a band, the Superior Band, you understand, him and Bunk Johnson.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well at that time then, you didn't have no violin, you didn't have no band. Sure.

Who was some of the violin players? Well, I could remember a good old man Robichaux and Peter Bucker and a guy who was a guy who was a guy who was a guy who was a guy who was a guy who was a guy who was a guy who was and Peter Bocard and Jimmy Pollard. Well they had many more other violin players, I didn't know it, I think. Yeah. Yeah, I didn't know it. Who did Peter Bocard play with? Well Peter was, they had a band, the Superior Band, you understand, him and Bunk Johnson. Did you see the picture of Watson? Yeah,…

Mmhmm. One time I was talking to Joe Robichaux and he says he saw Big Eye Lewis with his dad, his uncle's band, and he said he didn't know that Big Eye wasn't any musician, he thought Big Eye was reading all those poets and he just faked them. Well at the time Daniel, let me
